paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled "Evaluation of ChatGPT VS various algorithms," illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis algorithms—VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT—on a vertical axis labeled "Accuracy," which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear increments, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The horizontal axis lists the three algorithms as categories. The chart employs a legend to distinguish the bars: VADER is represented by a solid white bar, TextBlob by a white bar with diagonal hatching, and ChatGPT by a solid green bar. The accuracy values are approximately 0.7 for VADER, 0.6 for TextBlob, and 0.9 for ChatGPT, with the bars arranged in the order of the algorithms on the x-axis and not sorted by value. The bars are not shaded or annotated beyond their color and pattern, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
